WORKSHEET · CLASS 34 · AGES 4–5

Order of Seasons: Tree Changes Worksheet for Ages 4–5

A seasons-and-trees worksheet for ages 4–5: order the same tree through spring, summer, autumn and winter, match leaf colours and trace the word SEASON. Printable.

THE WORKSHEET

The full sheet, exactly as the artist drew it.

See the whole sheet, download the original file or print it from your browser. Want your child to solve it on screen first? The interactive version lives at preschool/4-years/weather-seasons-and-what-we-wear/worksheets/order-of-seasons-tree-changes/ / — same sheet, drawing layer included.

← Light SourcesPrevious worksheetPrecipitation: Hail, Sleet and Snow →Next worksheet
HOW TO USE IT

The five steps on the sheet.

  1. 1

    Order

    Put the four tree pictures in season order, spring first.

  2. 2

    Circle

    Circle everything that changes on the tree.

  3. 3

    Match

    Match each tree to its leaf colours.

  4. 4

    Trace

    Trace the big word SEASON and write it too.

  5. 5

    Draw

    Draw the same tree in two seasons of your choice.

Before you start, have the words ready: The season order (spring, summer, autumn, winter) and the leaf colour that names each.

WHY IT HELPS

What this worksheet teaches.

One tree, four looks — the seasons come in an order and the tree keeps the calendar.

Watching one object change across the cycle makes the sequence real — the tree is the proof.

  • Season ordering
  • Observing change over time
  • Colour matching
  • Tracing and writing
  • Prediction
FOR GROWN-UPS

Tips, questions and practice.

Say before you start: Same tree, four costumes. Let us put the year in order.

Questions to ask: Which tree is outside your window right now? What comes next for it?

Parent tips: Photograph one real tree monthly; the sheet predicts the next photo every time.

Home practice: Adopt the nearest tree: visit it once a month and name its season.
